# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large bundle of real, recorded phone calls from Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory base: Manali, Andarkuppam check-post, Chennai). After filtering out non-sales material — driver/loading coordination, Diwali-gift distribution logistics, attendance/app chatter, and near-empty snippets — a solid core of genuine sales conversations remains: inbound enquiries for metal roofing sheets (JSW, Asian/Indira Dhanush, Pragathi, Radiance, Color-on-Plus brands), polycarbonate sheets, puff panels, screws (Tata Agri, self-drilling), welding rods, and accessories (L-flash, cutters, ridges, gutters). There are also dealer/retailer calls (rate negotiation, scheme/discount talk, stock confirmation) and a handful of "wrong product" calls (UPVC sheet, liner sheet, GI sheet, MS channel) where the company had to redirect customers because it does not manufacture those items. The sample is broad but repetitive — many calls are short, transactional, and involve the same reps handling pricing/measurement confusion rather than classic persuasive selling. Given this, the playbook below is grounded strictly in what was actually said; where a product/price is not confirmed in the calls it is marked as "not available / redirected."

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what reps state in calls:

- **Metal Roofing Sheets (core product)** — "நம்ம company-ல JSW Roofing Sheets apply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்" [We apply/produce JSW roofing sheets]. Thickness range mentioned: 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.60mm.
  - **JSW Color-on-Plus** — flagship branded line, most frequently quoted (0.47mm standard).
  - **JSW Pragathi / Pragati Color-on-Plus** — slightly premium tier ("Pragathi color of plus Madam 445 + GST").
  - **JSW Radiance / Silver-on** — another JSW sub-brand, used interchangeably with Color-on-Plus in some quotes; reps note "Silver-on கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW Steel கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி" [Silver-on slightly costlier, JSW Steel slightly cheaper].
  - **Asian Indra Dhanush / Asian Force** — lower-tier/alternate brand, also quoted in coil and sheet form; "Indira Dhanush AZ70GSM ISI symbol இருக்கும்" [will have ISI mark].
- **Puff panels (wall + roof, insulated)** — separate factory/line: "நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet-ஓட இது இருக்கு" [we have tile-profile/puff line at another factory]. 50mm/40mm/30mm thickness variants mentioned.
- **Polycarbonate sheets (Lexan brand)** — clear/transparent, thickness options 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm; standard max length 15 ft ("polycarbonate-ஐ பொறுத்தவரைக்கும் 15 அடி தான் standard").
- **Accessories** — L-flash, cutter (ridge/corner flashing), ridge, gutter — custom-cut to diagram, priced per standard width (610mm) with double-rate penalty beyond that.
- **Screws** — Tata Agri self-drilling screws (various sizes: 1 inch, 2 inch, M8x55mm full-thread), rust-free variants.
- **Welding rods** — Tata brand, carton-based pricing, scheme-driven volume incentives.
- **Products explicitly NOT made/stocked (redirect calls):**
  - UPVC sheets — "UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir. Metal roofing sheet தான் இருக்குது."
  - Liner sheets — "liner நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே" [we don't make liner sheets at all]; reps redirect to competitors (Arumuga Steel, "Thiruvannamalai-ல ஓட்டுற production").
  - GI sheet (as distinct from metal roofing) — confusion call shows reps unsure, ultimately clarifying "நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் supply பண்ணிருக்கோம்."
  - MS Channel (JSW Structures, 125/65 channel) — rep forwards caller to a different contact number rather than quoting directly.
  - 1.2mm MS corrugated sheet — "சரி சார், நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் சார் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்" [we only make metal roofing sheet].

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color-on-Plus 0.47mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one call) and **₹445 + GST / sq.m** (multiple other calls) — rate varies by call/date, confirming prices are not fixed and should always be re-confirmed.
- JSW Pragathi Color-on-Plus: **₹445 + GST / sq.m**.
- 10 ft JSW sheet (converted): **₹1,466 + 18% GST** per sheet.
- Asian Indra Dhanush 0.45mm, 10 ft sheet: **₹1,251 + 18% GST + loading charge**.
- Nova Blue sheet: **₹445 + GST/sq.m**; same product quoted as **₹120 + GST/kg** (~₹142 effective with GST) in a kg-based conversation — rep converts: "₹120/kg + GST வரும்... ₹350–400 குள்ள இருக்கும்" for ~400kg.
- Asian Force 0.45 Indra Dhanush: **₹370 + GST / sq.m**.
- Pragathi coil (Indira Dhanush) profile: **₹101 + tax**; raw coil ₹3 cheaper (~₹97–98).
- Polycarbonate (2mm, clear): **₹800 + GST / sq.m**.
- Puff panel (50mm thickness, metal-faced): **₹1,650 + GST / sq.m** (~₹2,000 effective with tax), quoted as running-meter equivalent for site measurements.
- Cutter/L-flash accessories: standard width up to **610mm = ₹655**; beyond 610mm width, **rate doubles** ("610mm-க்கு மேல width போச்சுனாலே full sheet use பண்ற மாதிரி... double the rate").
- Screws: 2 inch Tata Agri — dealer/consumer rate **₹4.44–4.66 + tax**; 1 inch — **₹2.93 + tax**; M8x55mm full thread — **₹4.44+tax**; small box (200 pcs) rate ~**₹5.95 + GST** per unit in one quote (full-thread agri screw).
- Welding rod carton: **₹356 including tax** (recently risen from ₹336, "₹330, ₹335 including tax" also quoted — competitor pressure noted).
- **Payment terms (stated repeatedly, consistent across calls):** 50% advance payment; balance
